aviation_incidents.headline: 華航CI840曼谷滑行時機輪陷入滑行道破洞 航班未能起飛、旅客多留一晚
aviation_incidents.summary: 華航CI840原訂10月28日晚間由曼谷飛往高雄，波音737-800滑行準備起飛時，機輪陷入滑行道地面破洞，飛機無法移動，航班未能起飛。旅客下機搭接駁車離開，華航安排住宿，旅客在曼谷多留一晚；破洞成因及飛機是否受損仍待官方釐清。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: China Airlines CI840 Gets Stuck in Bangkok Taxiway Hole and Does Not Depart, Leaving Passengers to Stay Overnight
aviation_incidents.summary_en: China Airlines flight CI840 was scheduled to fly from Bangkok to Kaohsiung on the evening of October 28. As its Boeing 737-800 taxied for departure, its wheels became trapped in a hole in the taxiway pavement, leaving the aircraft unable to move and the flight unable to depart. Passengers disembarked and left by shuttle bus; China Airlines arranged accommodation, and they stayed an extra night in Bangkok. The cause of the hole and whether the aircraft was damaged remain unclear pending official findings.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣國籍航空近期部分歐洲航班飛越俄羅斯領空 交通部尊重業者航路安排
taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部長陳世凱10月28日表示，國籍航空公司近期部分歐洲航班飛越俄羅斯領空，航路由航空公司申請，交通部與民航局尊重業者規劃。華航飛羅馬及長榮飛慕尼黑、巴黎、米蘭的航班近期均採此航路；航空公司考量飛安與時間成本選擇路徑。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwanese Carriers Recently Fly Some European Routes Over Russian Airspace, and the Transport Ministry Respects Their Route Choices
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Transport Minister Chen Shih-kai said on October 28 that some Taiwanese carriers’ recent European flights had flown over Russian airspace. Airlines apply for their own flight paths, and the ministry and Civil Aeronautics Administration respect their plans. Recent China Airlines flights to Rome and EVA Air flights to Munich, Paris and Milan used the route; airlines weigh safety and time costs when selecting paths.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 國籍航空近期飛越俄羅斯領空 交長：尊重業者安排

international_aviation.headline: 印度新創Nalwa Aero完成箱型翼eVTOL縮比機試飛 驗證懸停與前飛能力
international_aviation.summary: 印度新創Nalwa Aero完成箱型翼電動垂直起降航空器縮比機的初步飛行測試，以電力推進及全傾轉旋翼系統驗證懸停與向前飛行能力。公司計畫進一步發展五座平臺，供載客、空中救護及貨運使用。
international_aviation.headline_en: Indian Startup Nalwa Aero Completes Scaled Box-Wing eVTOL Test Flights, Demonstrating Hover and Forward Flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Indian startup Nalwa Aero completed preliminary flight tests of a scaled box-wing electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, demonstrating hover and forward flight with electric propulsion and an all-tilting-rotor system. The company plans to develop the concept into a five-seat platform for passenger transport, air ambulance and cargo operations.

international_aviation.headline: Jet2退役服役29年的全球最老波音737-800 G-GDFD 結束飛行生涯
international_aviation.summary: Jet2已退役註冊號G-GDFD的波音737-800，結束這架服役29年、全球最老同型機的飛行生涯。該機10月18日執行末班商業航班LS644，從伊比薩飛往東米德蘭茲，當天再飛往曼徹斯特除去塗裝，準備歸還出租人。
international_aviation.headline_en: Jet2 Retires 29-Year-Old G-GDFD, the World’s Oldest Boeing 737-800, Ending Its Flying Career
international_aviation.summary_en: Jet2 has retired Boeing 737-800 G-GDFD, ending the flying career of the 29-year-old aircraft, described as the world’s oldest of its type. It operated its final commercial flight, LS644, from Ibiza to East Midlands on October 18, then flew to Manchester the same day for de-branding ahead of its return to the lessor.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — Jet2 retires world’s oldest Boeing 737-800 after 29 years

international_aviation.headline: 美國貿易代表質疑歐投行空巴研發貸款 警告航空航太貿易面臨不確定性
international_aviation.summary: 美國貿易代表格里爾於10月26日質疑歐洲投資銀行對空中巴士的融資支持，稱此事為跨大西洋航空航太貿易帶來重大不確定性。該行批准最高30億歐元貸款，供空巴在法國、德國及西班牙研發；空巴稱這是標準企業融資安排，並願提供更多資訊。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. Trade Representative Questions EIB Airbus R&D Loan, Warning of Uncertainty for Aerospace Trade
international_aviation.summary_en: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer questioned the European Investment Bank’s financing support for Airbus on October 26, saying it brought substantial uncertainty to transatlantic aerospace trade. The bank approved up to €3 billion for Airbus research and development in France, Germany and Spain. Airbus called the loan a standard corporate financing arrangement and said it was willing to provide more information.

international_aviation.headline: 波音因機翼產能不足將錯失2026年約500架737 MAX交付目標 每月增產時程延後
international_aviation.summary: 波音表示，Renton機翼產能不足將使公司無法達成2026年交付約500架737 MAX的目標。每月47架的穩定生產時程延至2027年初，每月52架則延至2027年下半年；進一步增產仍取決於美國聯邦航空總署對Everett新產線的生產認證。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing to Miss 2026 Target of About 500 737 MAX Deliveries as Wing Capacity Shortfall Delays Production Ramp-Up
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing said insufficient wing production capacity at Renton means it will miss its target of delivering about 500 737 MAX aircraft in 2026. Stabilising production at 47 aircraft per month has been pushed to early 2027, while the target of 52 per month has slipped to the second half of 2027. Further growth also depends on FAA production certification for the new Everett line.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍授予洛克希德馬丁6.94億美元合約生產ARRW極音速飛彈
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍10月26日宣布，已於9月29日授予洛克希德馬丁6.94億美元合約，生產並部署AGM-183A空射快速反應武器。空軍基於作戰安全考量，未公布採購數量及交付時間。ARRW整合於B-52轟炸機，空軍將同時推進這款助推滑翔武器與HACM兩條空射極音速武器路線。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. Air Force Awards Lockheed Martin $694 Million Contract to Produce ARRW Hypersonic Weapon
international_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. Air Force announced on October 26 that it had awarded Lockheed Martin a $694 million contract on September 29 to produce and field the AGM-183A Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon. For operational security, the Air Force did not disclose the quantity or delivery schedule. Integrated on the B-52, ARRW is a boost-glide weapon; the service is pursuing it alongside the HACM as its two air-launched hypersonic programs.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士與法國航空完成A350支援合資公司設立 合約支援逾500架飛機
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士與法國航空於2026年10月28日完成設立持股各半的Alpha Component Solutions，為全球A350營運商提供零組件、維護、供應鏈管理及修理服務。該公司整合空巴與法航－荷航工程維護資源，目前依合約支援超過500架飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus and Air France Finalise A350 Support Joint Venture, Which Contractually Supports More Than 500 Aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus and Air France finalised a 50-50 joint venture, Alpha Component Solutions, on October 28, 2026, to support A350 operators worldwide with components, maintenance, supply-chain management and repairs. Combining Airbus and Air France-KLM engineering and maintenance resources, the venture contractually supports more than 500 aircraft.
